semantics.p: High-level transparent latch: while clock=1 p follows a; while clock=0 p holds the value from the end of the preceding high phase.
semantics.q: Negative-edge flip-flop captures p on each falling edge of clock and otherwise holds.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior.
semantics.initialization: No initialization; p and q start unknown in four-state simulation. p becomes defined when clock first goes high; q becomes defined on a falling edge after p is defined.
semantics.edge_order: At a simultaneous clock falling edge and a change, p holds its pre-edge value and q captures that held value, matching 115ns and 175ns.
semantics.latency: p transparent during high phase; q updates only on falling clock edges.

numeric.type: Single-bit four-state logic; no arithmetic, signedness, overflow, rounding or saturation.

verification.waveform: Replay every row of the original waveform and use case-inequality comparisons after settling, including initial unknown outputs.
verification.directed: Exercise both input values during high and low phases, verify p transparency and hold and q falling-edge capture, including simultaneous input/clock changes.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, explicit dev_tb top, -g2012, finite external compile and simulation timeouts; testbench watchdog.

specification_ambiguities: Finite waveforms do not uniquely specify all possible circuits; infer the minimal high-transparent latch for p and falling-edge storage of p for q. No additional behavior is specified for unknown clock or input values.
